name: La Cime
dinnerNote: Tasting menu, about 13 courses; tax and service included
lunchNoteJa: ランチも同じコース・土曜日

menus.name: tasting menu
menus.note: The only menu, lunch or dinner: five amuse-bouches, four starters, two mains, pre-dessert and dessert, then petits fours and tea; tax and service included, plus 15% for the private room

bookingOpens: Online (taken at any hour, with separate Japanese and English booking pages) or by phone. A booking is confirmed only once guests reply to the restaurant's confirmation email, sent within a few days; the restaurant also calls or emails about three days before to reconfirm, and unconfirmed bookings may be cancelled.
cancellation: Cancellations or reductions in party size on the day before or the day itself are charged a fee; cancel by phone by the day before at the latest.
groups: One private room seats up to six, at an extra 15%. Parties of five or more are seated in it, as are smaller parties when the dining room is full, with the same charge.
dressCode: No set dress code, but no shorts or flip-flops.
children: Only children old enough to eat the adult menu.
